fusions.name: Tangle Shot
fusions.desc: Throws a snaring cord that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and has a 70% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Snared Finish
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow, which deals 18 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Slip the Mesh
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds, with +10% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Loose Weave
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a ward that absorbs 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.
